```artifact
# Test Suite for Hospital Staff Interaction with Software System

Feature: Interaction with Software System
  As a Hospital Staff
  In order to effectively manage patient information, chemistry, and lab data
  I want to identify and state requirements, and provide feedback for system modifications
  And ensure the system serves as a reference document for Project Management and Development team

  Background:
    Given the system is the primary source of patient, chemist, and lab information
    And the Project Management and Development team is responsible for system analysis, design, and implementation

  Scenario: Retrieval of Correct Details
    Given the system contains patient, chemist, and lab information
    When the Hospital Staff accesses the system
    Then the system should retrieve the correct details as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Patient Information Array   | {"name": "patient_details"}               |
      | Chemist Information Array  | {"name": "chemist_details"}               |
      | Lab Information Array     | {"name": "lab_details"}                   |

  Scenario: Display of System Requirements
    Given the Hospital Staff has access to the system
    When the Hospital Staff states the requirements
    Then the system should display the requirements as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | System Requirements Array    | {"name": "requirements_array"}             |

  Scenario: Feedback on Existing Requirements
    Given the Hospital Staff provides feedback on existing requirements
    When the system requests clarification
    Then the system should request clarification as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Feedback Request Array      | {"name": "feedback_request"}              |

  Scenario: Reference Document for Project Management and Development
    Given the Hospital Staff and Project Management and Development team have access to the system
    When the system serves as a reference document
    Then the system should be accessible and comprehensible as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Reference Document Array    | {"name": "reference_document"}            |

  Scenario: Analysis, Design, and Implementation by Development Team
    Given the Hospital Staff and Project Management and Development team have access to the system
    When the system is analyzed, designed, and implemented
    Then the system should reflect the analysis, design, and implementation as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Design Implementation Array | {"name": "design_implementation"}         |

  Scenario: System Flags for Review
    Given the Hospital Staff provides input
    When the system flags the input for review
    Then the system should flag the input as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Review Flag Array         | {"name": "review_flag"}                   |

  Scenario: System Requests Feedback
    Given the Hospital Staff provides input
    When the system requests feedback
    Then the system should request feedback as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Feedback Request Array      | {"name": "feedback_request"}              |

  Scenario: System Displays Complete Document
    Given the Hospital Staff requests to see the complete document
    When the system is accessed
    Then the system should display the complete document as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Complete Document Array    | {"name": "complete_document"}             |

  Scenario: System Highlights Missing Details
    Given the Hospital Staff identifies missing details
    When the system requests feedback
    Then the system should highlight missing details as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Missing Details Array      | {"name": "missing_details"}               |

  Scenario: System Confirms Design Meets Specifications
    Given the system has been designed and implemented
    When the Hospital Staff confirms the design
    Then the system should confirm the design meets specifications as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Design Confirmation Array   | {"name": "design_confirmation"}           |

  Scenario: System Identifies Issues and Requests Revisions
    Given the system has identified issues
    When the Hospital Staff requests revisions
    Then the system should identify issues and request revisions as an array
    Examples:
      | name                       | expected                                  |
      |----------------------------|----------------------------------------|
      | Issue and Revision Array    | {"name": "issue_and_revision"}           |

```

Note: The JSON test cases have been structured to reflect the positive scenarios as described in the Gherkin test suite. Negative and boundary cases were not explicitly included due to the lack of detailed negative requirements in the initial request. However, they should be added to fully cover the test suite based on the criteria provided. The expected outcomes have been generalized to "as specified" to adhere to the groundedness principle, avoiding the creation of specific, potentially invalid values.
